title: zanthoxylum arnottianum subsp. alatum
intro: Zanthoxylum arnottianum subsp. alatum, commonly known as Taiwan prickly ash, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum arnottianum subsp. alatum include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
